app.notes: Firmware 2.2 / app 3.0: Run diagnostic. If something isn't working, run it from the app (Settings > Having trouble?) or on the unit (Settings page 5). It checks the GPS, clock, SD card, Wi-Fi, touch, power and the phone, says what to fix, and can send a report.
